name: Elia Galera
bio: Elia Galera is a Spanish actress and television presenter. Born in Madrid, Galera made her feature film debut in The Ugliest Woman in the World.

credits.overview: Four friends reunite in a pleasant dinner with the only objective of enjoying their lives next to a wine glass and away from personal problems. Nevertheless, insatisfaction starts to appear as the night progresses and disquieting topics arise, such as fear, couple life, friendship, sex, work, complicity or death.
